mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM current_loan WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan (account_id, book_id, policy_id, policy_version, max_active_loans_snapshot, loan_days_snapshot, borrowed_at, due_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{bookId}, #{policyId}, #{policyVersion}, #{maxActiveLoansSnapshot}, #{loanDaysSnapshot}, #{borrowedAt}, #{dueAt}, #{borrowedAt}, #{borrowedAt})

INSERT INTO current_loan (loan_id, account_id, book_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT id, account_id, book_id, #{now}, #{now} FROM loan WHERE id = #{loanId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND returned_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE loan SET returned_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND returned_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM current_loan WHERE loan_id = #{loanId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
